name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary cost drivers are material selections, the overall square footage, and whether plumbing or electrical lines need to be relocated. Keeping the toilet, shower, and vanity in their original positions significantly reduces labor costs because it avoids opening subfloors or running new supply lines. In contrast, moving fixtures, upgrading electrical panels for heated floors, choosing natural stone over ceramic tile, or replacing hidden water-damaged subflooring increases expenses. Setting a defined scope and picking finishes before construction starts helps avoid costly change orders.
acceptedAnswer.description: Layout changes, plumbing relocation, tile and fixture material grades, and unexpected water damage repair behind walls have the largest impact on total remodeling costs.
